node.statement: The amended binding prefix of root node 1 universally fixes precisely a W_RF, an input (H,Phi,eta) in the domain of lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation, and a supplied setting datum S. Universally instantiate that validated external at this input: its hypotheses/domain give H nonzero finite-dimensional, Phi UCP, 0<=eta<=rho_id^corr, and ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta, while its conclusion says that the fields of S include the canonical functional-calculus tilde-Phi and A=Im(tilde-Phi). Thus every fact asserted in node 1.1.1.1 is inherited from the amended root and the allowed external; none is introduced as a new hypothesis.
